question.text: If a NIFTY 25,000 call option is bought at Rs 300 and NIFTY expires at 25,500, what is the profit per lot (lot size 25)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Profit per unit equals payoff minus premium: max(25,500 - 25,000, 0) - 300 = 200. Contract profit is per-unit profit times the lot size stated in the question: 200 × 25 = Rs 5,000. The Trap: Rs 12,500 uses gross payoff (500 × 25) without subtracting premium. Rs 7,500 subtracts only half the premium. Rs 2,500 uses a wrong lot size. Note: Contract size is exchange-determined and can change; this calculation uses the lot size of 25 stated in the question.
